about_the_game:
Experience the FYR: The Lost Island Demo, a focused prologue chapter that takes place before the events of the full game.

Step onto the desolate shores of an isolated Norwegian Island, a place shrouded in mystery and haunted by the remnants of a forgotten past. Once a thriving fishing community, the island now lies in eerie silence. As you explore the abandoned island, each clue, note, and hidden relic unveils more of its dark history.

You are not alone. A relentless monster hunts you through the shadows, its presence felt in every creak and whisper, closing in when you least expect it. With no weapons to defend yourself, you must use your wits to evade its clutches, hiding and outsmarting it at every turn. This creature is drawn to light and sound, forcing you to tread carefully as you uncover the secrets of the island.

The island's eerie ambiance, combined with the immersive power of VR, creates a visceral horror experience that places you right in the heart of a terrifying mystery. Feel the fear build with every creak, shadow, and chilling detail as you navigate a dynamic environment. Every interaction is designed to blur the line between reality and nightmare, drawing you fully into this hauntingly beautiful world.

The darkness is vast, and light is a precious, fragile thing. As you explore, your light will help you reveal hidden clues, navigate complex environments, and stave off the creature that hunts you. But beware—using light recklessly may attract unwanted attention. Finding a balance between visibility and safety is essential to your survival. In Project Lost Island, the simple act of carrying a light becomes a constant tension between discovery and risk, a reminder that in this world, even light can be a double-edged sword.

Use light to reveal the hidden history of the island, unveiling ghostly projections that recount the lives and struggles of those who vanished. Each flicker uncovers fragments of the island’s tragic story, drawing you deeper into its mystery and pushing you closer to the truth. Shine your light, confront the darkness, and piece together secrets lost to time.

short_description: FYR: The Lost Island is a psychological VR horror game that plunges you into the mystery of an abandoned island. Navigate haunting environments, evade a relentless monster, and use light to uncover hidden stories that piece together the island’s tragic history.
